name: Bloodmoss
text: Red moss from swamp stones. On the alchemy recipe map it pulls toward healing and away from poison.

name: Bounty Writ
text: A sealed notice from the bounty board. Heroes carry it as proof they may claim the reward.

name: Emberroot
text: A root that stays warm for a year after it is pulled. Pulls brews toward fire and fire resistance.

name: Ghostcap
text: A pale mushroom from crypts. Pulls brews toward truth serums and seeing the unseen.

name: Ley Crystal
text: A crystal grown on a ley line. Enchanting uses it to power gear and wall wards; mage towers burn it as fuel.

name: Relic Fragment
text: A shard of a broken holy or unholy relic, found in ruins and tombs. Enchanting steers an imbued effect with it; some fragments whisper.

name: Town Ration
text: Bread, cheese and salt pork from the town's own stores. Parties bought locally keep the bakers and farms busy.

name: Wardsalt
text: Blessed salt from the temple. Pulls brews toward warding and is poured along thresholds against the dead.
